# Studentkare

> Student-owned health record and care services for Indian campuses. Students keep their own records, book care from listed providers, and get cited health information from an assistant that does not diagnose.

## Public pages
- [Home & care services](https://studentkare.co/shop): Wellness products, lab test packages and doctor consultations from listed providers.
- [Plans](https://studentkare.co/pricing): Student plans and campus (enterprise) plans.
- [Sign up](https://studentkare.co/signup): Account creation with one-time code sign-in (18+ only).

## Principles
- Students own their records; campuses and payers get no access to individual health data without the student's consent.
- The assistant answers from approved sources with citations and refuses to diagnose or prescribe; crisis messages are routed to Tele-MANAS (14416) and emergency services (112/108).

## Contact
- Security: security@studentkare.co
